title: Restore the quoted-pipe titleless-completion control's real ACP exit fidelity
outcome: The qualified full-launch negative control accurately describes its synthetic end and uses the exit classification of the real titleless ACP frame while preserving the no-credit/qualified-pipe assertions.
acceptance: The control uses the real ACP titleless frame's exit classification or a documented equivalent, and its comments identify any synthetic boundary accurately.
The qualified-pipe launch remains refused with no carried/verification credit; existing negative assertions remain meaningful.
